description: analogRead on A0, A7, A8 and A15 of the Mega 2560 with the default, the 1.1 V and the 2.56 V reference.
basis: ATmega2560 datasheet 26.8: ADC = floor(Vin * 1024 / Vref) limited to 1023, Vref = VCC (5 V) for DEFAULT, 1.1 V for INTERNAL1V1, 2.56 V for INTERNAL2V56; channels 8-15 are selected with MUX5 (ADCSRB) and MUX2:0; computed by hand: 2.51 V -> 514, 5 V -> 1023, 1.1 V -> 225, 0.612 V -> 125 (DEFAULT), 569 (1.1 V), 244 (2.56 V); analogRead(15) names the channel as the core allows channel or pin numbers
